entities.summary: Kim (Keimpe) Henry Veltman was a Dutch-Canadian historian, consultant and author who was director of the Virtual Maastricht McLuhan Institute (VMMI). He is known for his contributions in the fields of "linear perspective and the visual dimensions of science and art," new media, culture and society.
